title: Simple NBT
description: A very basic NBT tag viewer. Does not overcomplicate with a bunch of useless features.
body:
# Simple NBT
A very simple fabric mod that does what it promises. It adds all NBT tags as a description to the item itself. Other mods require a command to run, this one is fast, simple and has no extra fancy addons.

![Custom item with NBT tag](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/328f1d2aa656d76cee2243f572c59bbc13068cfe.png)

## Mod menu

There is a mod menu present to modify how the NBT info is displayed: nested, flat, colorful, dark, ... .
